bills.title: Family Assistance Legislation Amendment (Child Care Subsidy) Bill 2021

name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2021-08-12.21.1) to the usual [second reading](https://peo.gov.au/understand-our-parliament/how-parliament-works/bills-and-laws/making-a-law-in-the-australian-parliament/) motion "*that the bill be read for a second time*," which is parliamentary jargon for agreeing with the main idea of the bill. This means that the amendment failed. ### Motion text > *At the end of the motion, add ", and the Senate calls on the Government to acknowledge that:* > > *(a) it has a duty of care to avoid the harmful impacts of climate change on Australia's children; and* > > *(b) in light of the latest IPCC report, supporting new and expanded coal, oil and gas projects is negligent dereliction of that duty".*
